Hymn 79: With All the Power of Heart and Tongue

This is hymn number 79 titled "With All the Power of Heart and Tongue" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William Croft and the lyrics were written by Isaac Watts.
